question: for each centre show the average turnout rate in both years next to each other

Return SQL only. Never write files, install software, calculate values yourself, or invent columns.

for each centre show the average turnout rate in both years next to each other

WITH
attendance_2023_rates AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre",
        AVG(CAST("Avg Daily Present" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("Enrolled Kids", 0)) * 100 AS avg_turnout_rate_2023
    FROM
        "attendance_2023"
    GROUP BY
        "Centre"
),
attendance_2024_rates AS (
    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS "Centre",
        AVG(CAST("average_attendance" AS FLOAT) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0)) * 100 AS avg_turnout_rate_2024
    FROM
        "attendance_2024"
    GROUP BY
        "centre_name"
)
SELECT
    a2023."Centre",
    a2023.avg_turnout_rate_2023,
    a2024.avg_turnout_rate_2024
FROM
    attendance_2023_rates a2023
LEFT JOIN
    attendance_2024_rates a2024 ON a2023."Centre" = a2024."Centre"
